content:
**Mirelurk Egg Omelette** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A Mirelurk Egg that has been cooked into an omelet over a fire. It gives a 30 minute boost to AP regen while restoring a moderate amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a moderate dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Mirelurk Egg (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Mirelurk Egg | | Mirelurk Egg Omelette (1) | 

It can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after picking up a Mirelurk Egg for the first time.

The spelling is that of British English. "Omelet" is the American English spelling. [1]
